main_text.p: pondo argenti misti ualeat 15. Sumpta autem sunt argenti pondo 33 pretij 16, quot pondo è cæteris generibus sumenda sunt?
Hic pars numerorum optatorum data est 33. Itaq; alternatis differentijs, ut uides,

Pro primo proportionis termino sumo differentiam attributā extremo, cuius mensuræ numero datæ sunt, nempe 1 pondo pretij 16: pro tertio autem datum mensurarum numerum, nempe 33 pondo pretij 16. Itaq; propositam quæstionē tribus simplicibus proportionibus concludo. Prima proportio sic est:
1 pondo pretij 16, requirit 1 pondo pretij 14: ergo, 33 pondo pretij 16, requirunt 33 pondo pretij 14.
1 pondo pretij 16, requirunt 3 pondo pretij 20: ergo 33 pondo pretij 16, requirunt 99 pondo pretij 20.
1 pondo pretij 16, requirit 5 pondo pretij 12: ergo 33 pondo pretij 16, requirunt 165 pondo pretij 12.

page.notes: Right-hand page is largely cut off at the scan edge; its fragments were not transcribed. Layout of the diagram of alternations is reconstructed as lines. Some numerals in the alternation diagram are uncertain.
